'''Gong Xingao''' ({{zh|s=龚新高|t=龔新高|p=Gōng Xīngāo}}; born June 1962) is a Chinese physicist. He is a computational physicist best known for studying [[computational physics]].

==Biography==
Gong was born into a family of farming background in June 1962 in [[Ansha, Changsha|Ansha Town]] of [[Changsha County]], [[Hunan]]. He is the youngest of seven children. His parents died early. Gong secondary studied at Changsha County No. 3 High School.<ref>{{cite news|author=Jiang Guo |url=https://www.icswb.com/newspaper_article-detail-278775.html |script-title=zh:从放牛娃到中科院院士 |work=icswb.com |date=2017-12-04 |language=zh}}</ref> In July 1982 he graduated from [[Hunan Normal University]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://xiaoban.hunnu.edu.cn/info/1034/4341.htm |script-title=zh:我校校友龚新高、邵明安当选中科院院士 |work=Hunan Normal University |date=2017-12-28 |language=zh}}</ref> He received his master's degree and doctor's degree in science from the Institute of Solid State Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1985 and 1993, respectively.

He joined the faculty of [[Fudan University]] in 2000.<ref>{{cite news |title=2017 International Symposium on Multi-Scale Modeling & Simulation of Materials Held in IMR |url=http://english.imr.cas.cn/news/newsrelease/201708/t20170801_181659.html |access-date=8 October 2018 |work=imr.cas.cn |date=17 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://phys.fudan.edu.cn/e5/e3/c7451a124387/page.htm |script-title=zh:热烈祝贺龚新高教授当选中国科学院院士 |work=Fudan University |date=2017-11-28 |language=zh}}</ref>

In 2009 he was elected a member of the [[American Physical Society]]. He became a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] on November 28, 2017.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |script-title=zh:关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告 |work=cas.cn |date=2017-11-28 |language=zh |access-date=2018-10-08 |archive-date=2018-08-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180801191730/http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> 

==Awards==
* 1999 China National Funds for Distinguished Young Scientists
* 2012 Second Class Prize of State Natural Science Award
